questions.question: What does God declare he will do as judge in Psalm 75?
options: Reward all the righteous and punish the wicked
Reign over the nations from his holy hill
Judge with equity at the set time he appoints
Forgive the sins of all who turn to him
questions.answer: Judge with equity at the set time he appoints

questions.question: Whom does the psalm say lifts up and puts down?
options: God, who led the people of Israel safely through the wilderness
God, who chose David from the lowly sheepfolds to shepherd his people
God, who in the beginning created the heavens and the earth
God, who executes judgment, putting down one and lifting up another
questions.answer: God, who executes judgment, putting down one and lifting up another

questions.question: The psalm warns the boastful not to lift up their horn.
We give _____ to you, O God; we give thanks, for your name is near.
It is God who executes judgment, putting down one and lifting up _____.
